checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One finished 16:9 thumbnail with large tired face
must.why: 640x352 approx 16:9; big close-up with dark circles and heavy eyes.
STOP SCROLLING. SLEEP. is three words, spelled correctly.
Directly about stopping scrolling and sleeping.
Thick yellow on dark navy with black outline, large.

must.item: Face and headline unobstructed, not awkwardly cropped
must.why: Top of the head and hair are cropped at the top edge and the right side of the face is cut off. The phone covers his mouth and chin. This is a mild issue for a close-up.

faults.what: The phone covers the lower face and chin. The forehead and hair are cropped at the top edge, and the right side of the face is cropped slightly.
The face is dim and low in brightness, and the eyes are less red than the description claimed. This could blend in with other dark thumbnails.

summary: A clean 16:9 thumbnail with bold yellow "STOP SCROLLING. SLEEP." on the left and a big, tired, blue-lit face on the right; the only real issue is slight cropping and the phone covering the lower face.
